findings.evidence: reveal awaits runAction after entering drumroll. run-action.ts:9–14 awaits authorizedFetch and response.json without a deadline; client-fetch.ts:authorizedFetch supplies no default deadline. The reveal button (373) and previous/revisit/next controls (470–476) remain disabled while drumroll persists. A rejected acknowledgement simply clears phase and says Could not apply the result (237), without authoritative reconciliation.
findings.userImpact: A stalled write/body can strand the operator in Applying result. A lost acknowledgement can invite another application despite an unknown committed result.
findings.suggestedFix: Bound the full operation; announce an unknown outcome, reconcile the applicant’s authoritative stage result, and require reconciliation before enabling repeat application. Cover stalled body and committed-write/lost-response cases.

findings.evidence: The result failure is rendered as an ordinary footer paragraph. The separate live region reports drumroll/stamped states but does not include error; failure resets phase and empties that region. No failure focus transfer is present.
findings.userImpact: A screen-reader operator activating Reveal can receive Applying room result without an announced explanation when application fails.
findings.suggestedFix: Expose failure/uncertainty in a persistent alert or live region and keep a reachable recovery action; verify failure announcement and keyboard continuation.
